reasoning_summary: All build gates are technically met and the scoring total (6.6) clears the 6.5 threshold, so build_now is structurally permissible. However, the cost-to-gain ratio of 4.45 is catastrophically above the kill threshold of 0.6 defined in cost_gain_model.yaml, and even the optimistic scenario (2.23) is nearly 4× the kill line. With 32 customers needed to break even, $960 build cost, and only ~$191 expected gain in 30 days, committing a build slot now is premature. The responsiveness_signal score of 2 (no outreach test data) means we have zero evidence that the target segment will actually convert. Deferring one week to run a lightweight responsiveness probe (HN/LinkedIn outreach to AI engineers about this pain) would either validate conversion potential or confirm the kill — far cheaper than a speculative build.
suggested_first_outreach_channel: Direct DM/email to commenters on the original HN thread and similar LLM-degradation threads, plus targeted LinkedIn outreach to 'AI Engineer' / 'ML Platform' titles at companies with public AI agent products
